text: Here I am within a sleek, modern space, confronted by glass, crisp lighting, and vivid color. As I move closer to the exhibition wall marked 'R + D', I feel a curious exhilaration—the promise of ideas, the interplay of technology and human ingenuity. Surrounded by research, innovation, and reflection, I sense a blend of anticipation and humility. My mind dances with the creative tension between what is known and what remains mysterious, marveling at the ongoing attempt to understand our existence more deeply.
